title: Spiral Matrix
statement:
Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order.

Spiral order means traversing the matrix starting from the top-left, moving right along the top row, then down the right column, then left along the bottom row, then up the left column, and repeating this pattern inward until all elements are visited.
constraints: matrix[i][j] is an integer between -100 and 100

visibleExamples.explanation: Traverse right along top row, down right column, left along bottom row, up left column, then center element.
